outcome: Neonatal cord blood vitamin B12 levels
cohort: The study included 832 pregnant women aged >=16 years admitted for delivery and their 832 newborn infants.
finding: Vitamin B12 deficiency is highly prevalent in pregnant women before delivery and significantly correlates with cord blood homocysteine and vitamin B12 levels, although homocysteine alone is not a reliable marker for maternal vitamin B12 status.
cross-section timing: During admission for delivery and immediately after birth (cord blood sampling)
